name: Xi'an ESWIN Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an ESWIN Material Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sales of 12-inch polished single-crystal silicon wafers and epitaxial wafers. It also provides polishing pads and after-sales services. The company's products are used in memory chips, logic chips, analog chips, image sensors, power chips, advanced packaging, display driver chips, power management chips, and power devices such as IGBTs and Power MOSFETs. Xi'an ESWIN Material Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2016 and is based in Xi'an, China.
